subject: Project kit & timeline for coding exercise / reviewer pairing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@gmail.com>
Cc: TalentBridge Recruiting <recruiter@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Project kit & timeline for coding exercise / reviewer pairing

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time to move forward in our interview process. Attached is the project kit we discussed: a short back-end inference design task plus a small implementation component. Key details:

- Deadline: 72 hours from when you acknowledge receipt (initially 2027-06-17 09:12 PT)
- Deliverables: PDF writeup (design + operational notes) and a repo link or a zipped project with instructions
- Estimated time: ~4-6 hours

Attachments: redwood_takehome_prompt.pdf (prompt) and evaluation_rubric.xlsx (what reviewers will grade).

Please reply to confirm you received the prompt and whether the 72-hour window works. If you need a short extension, let us know the specific timing.

I'll be coordinating the reviewer schedule on our side — copying our interview ops folks.

Thanks,
— Soojin
Soogin Lee (Hiring Coordinator)
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Park <evan.park@gmail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project kit & timeline for coding exercise / reviewer pairing

Thanks Soojin — I got the packet and the rubric. Appreciate the clear guidance.

Quick ask: I have a prior commitment starting late Tuesday evening (personal travel). Would it be possible to get a 48-hour extension so my new deadline would be 2027-06-19 09:12 PT instead of the 17th? I want to make sure I can give the implementation the time it deserves.

If that works, I confirm I'll submit as a zip + link to a small repo.

Best,
Evan

Hi Evan —

Extension approved. New target: 2027-06-19 09:12 PT. Thanks for the heads up — appreciate you confirming the submission format (zip + repo link).

Recruiter: noted on the new date. We'll update our internal schedule and notify reviewers.

I'll send a follow-up with reviewer slots and expected feedback turnaround later today.

Best,
Soogin (for the hiring team)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@gmail.com>, TalentBridge Recruiting <recruiter@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Reviewer pairing + slots for Evan Park (coding exercise)

Hi Jonas / Dev —

Evan (candidate) asked for a 48-hour extension; I approved it. New submission deadline: 2027-06-19 09:12 PT. Please see the attached prompt and rubric in case you want to skim before submission lands.

Proposed reviewer plan (please confirm):
- Primary reviewer (technical, implementation): Jonas Weber — evaluate code quality, correctness, and design tradeoffs
- Secondary reviewer (systems + infra): Dev Patel — assess scalability, inference/runtime considerations, and operational notes

Proposed review timeline:
- Submission arrives 2027-06-19 morning
- Quick read + smoke test: same day afternoon (aim: 4–6h total across reviewers)
- Synchronous debrief: 2027-06-20 10:00–10:30 PT (30 min) — I'll book a calendar slot if both confirm

If either of you can't take the slot, propose an alternative or swap and I'll update the candidate and recruiter.

Links & attachments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_takehome_kits (prompt + rubric). Attachments: redwood_takehome_prompt.pdf, evaluation_rubric.xlsx

Thanks —
Soogin

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Internal: Reviewer pairing + slots for Evan Park (coding exercise)

Sounds good — I can take primary. I'll do an initial smoke test the afternoon of 6/19 and save notes in the rubric. Dev, can you take the 6/20 10:00 debrief? If you're unavailable, suggest 11:30 or 16:00 PT and I'll adjust.

I'll also add a brief notes doc to the Drive folder (reviewer_notes/jonas_evans.md).

Thanks,
Jonas
